stories.title: Iranian IRGC’s ties to Hezbollah deepen tensions in Lebanese politics
stories.summary: Lebanon's prime minister stated that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) is directing Hezbollah's operations, a view supported by analysts who say the Iranian group is making key decisions in Lebanese affairs.

stories.title: Israeli strike hits Tyre during Al Jazeera report
stories.summary: An Israeli missile struck a waterfront building in the Lebanese city of Tyre during a live Al Jazeera broadcast, interrupting the journalist's report.

stories.title: Moment rescuers find man alive under the rubble in Tehran
stories.summary: Rescue workers in Tehran extracted a man alive from rubble following US-Israeli strikes that hit a residential area in the Iranian capital.

stories.title: UN experts urge Israel to free Gaza doctor amid reports of ‘severe torture’
stories.summary: UN special rapporteurs have called on Israel to release detained Gaza doctor Hussam Abu Safia, warning he has been systematically denied medical treatment and reportedly subjected to severe torture while in Israeli custody.

stories.title: Philippines declares energy emergency over Iran conflict
stories.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr declared an energy emergency, citing imminent danger to the country's energy supplies caused by the conflict involving Iran.

stories.title: Israel says it will take control of large buffer zone in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli officials announced plans to take control of a large buffer zone in southern Lebanon, stating that displaced Lebanese residents cannot return until northern Israel is deemed safe.

stories.title: Search for four missing soldiers after Colombia plane crash kills 66
stories.summary: A Colombian military Hercules transport plane crashed shortly after takeoff near the country's southern border with Peru, killing 66 people, with search operations underway for four missing soldiers.

stories.title: At least five killed in massive wave of Russian strikes across Ukraine, officials say
stories.summary: Russian strikes hit eleven regions across Ukraine in one of the most severe attack waves in ten days, killing at least five people according to Ukrainian officials.

stories.title: Elon Musk's Starlink blocked from operating in Namibia
stories.summary: Namibia's telecommunications regulator blocked Elon Musk's Starlink from operating in the country, citing that the company's subsidiary does not meet local ownership requirements.

stories.title: Inside the alleged Russian operation to trigger anti-government protests in Angola
stories.summary: A group of Russians and Angolans are standing trial in Angola on accusations of organizing anti-government protests, charges which the defendants deny.

stories.title: UK universities flock to India - but will they succeed?
stories.summary: Nine UK universities are establishing campuses in India, though initial student enrollment is expected to be limited.

stories.title: A committed pharmacist and a homesick blogger – the Iranian civilians killed in the war
stories.summary: Civilian casualties in Iran continue to rise as the US-Israeli military campaign against the country progresses, with victims including a pharmacist and a blogger among those killed.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: A court in Cape Town, South Africa found former Scottish teacher Iain Wares guilty of indecently assaulting a former student, related to allegations of sexual abuse dating back to the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran shows no clear path to resolution, with Iran refusing to back down and US air power alone proving insufficient to achieve Washington's primary objectives.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian-driven vehicle while on his quad bike.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced its second nationwide power grid failure within a week, highlighting the country's ongoing energy crisis amid a US-imposed fuel blockade.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand its ground and air operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising concerns about a potential large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A car was stolen with a two-month-old baby boy inside, but police quickly rescued the infant unharmed and reunited him with his mother.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defence minister by Vice President Delcy Rodríguez.
